constraints.name: abastecimento_comprovante_abastecimento_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (abastecimento_id) REFERENCES abastecimento(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: fk_log_atividade_usuario
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (usuario_id) REFERENCES usuario(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: motorista_usuario_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (usuario_id) REFERENCES usuario(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: notificacao_demanda_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (tipo IS NULL OR viagem_id IS NOT NULL AND chave ~~ (((('viagem:'::text || viagem_id::text) || ':'::text) || lower(tipo)) || ':%'::text))

constraints.name: notificacao_usuario_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (usuario_id) REFERENCES usuario(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: solicitacao_obito_triagem_decisao_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status_triagem IS NULL OR status_triagem = 'AGUARDANDO_TRIAGEM'::status_triagem_svo AND triado_por_id IS NULL AND triado_em IS NULL OR (status_triagem = ANY (ARRAY['CONFIRMADA_SVO'::status_triagem_svo, 'ENCAMINHADA_IML'::status_triagem_svo])) AND triado_por_id IS NOT NULL AND triado_em IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: fk_solicitacao_viagem_motorista
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (motorista_id) REFERENCES motorista(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: fk_solicitacao_viagem_veiculo
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (veiculo_id) REFERENCES veiculo(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: solicitacao_viagem_retorno_previsto_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (data_hora_retorno_previsto IS NULL OR data_hora_retorno_previsto > data_hora_saida)

constraints.name: viagem_dados_obrigatorios_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (solicitacao_id IS NOT NULL AND veiculo_id IS NOT NULL AND motorista_id IS NOT NULL AND status IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID

constraints.name: viagem_execucao_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status IS DISTINCT FROM 'EM_TRANSPORTE'::status_viagem OR data_inicio IS NOT NULL AND km_inicial IS NOT NULL) AND (status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONCLUIDA'::status_viagem OR data_inicio IS NOT NULL AND km_inicial IS NOT NULL AND data_fim IS NOT NULL AND km_final IS NOT NULL)) NOT VALID

constraints.name: viagem_km_final_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (km_final IS NULL OR km_inicial IS NOT NULL AND km_final >= km_inicial) NOT VALID

constraints.name: viagem_km_inicial_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (km_inicial IS NULL OR km_inicial >= 0) NOT VALID

constraints.name: viagem_periodo_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (data_fim IS NULL OR data_inicio IS NOT NULL AND data_fim >= data_inicio) NOT VALID

constraints.name: viagem_validacao_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (validada_por_gestor IS NOT TRUE AND validada_por_id IS NULL AND validada_em IS NULL OR validada_por_gestor IS TRUE AND validada_por_id IS NOT NULL AND validada_em IS NOT NULL AND NOT status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONCLUIDA'::status_viagem) NOT VALID

constraints.name: viagem_correcao_km_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((km_inicial IS NULL OR km_inicial >= 0) AND (km_final IS NULL OR km_inicial IS NOT NULL AND km_final >= km_inicial))
